findings.title: Conditional inclusion method is missing the required question mark
findings.body: The method is defined as `include_website_name` instead of `include_website_name?`. Other inclusion predicates in this serializer use the `?` form, and ActiveModelSerializers only invokes `include_<attribute>?` to decide whether to emit an attribute. As a result this guard is never called, so `website_name` is emitted (as null) even when `website` is blank, instead of being omitted from the JSON.

findings.title: website_name bypasses the untrusted-user restriction applied to website
findings.body: `website_name` is added to the general attributes list but not to the `untrusted_attributes` list at lines 105-111, which hides `website`, `location`, bios, etc. from anonymous viewers of TL0 users via `scope.restrict_user_fields?`. Anonymous viewers therefore still receive the website host, and the full path when it matches the instance domain, even though the underlying `website` attribute is deliberately withheld from them.

findings.title: Invalid website URIs can raise during serialization after the rescued parse
findings.body: Only the first `URI(website.to_s).host` call on line 138 is protected by the modifier `rescue nil`. The subsequent `URI(website.to_s).path` calls on lines 143, 146 and 149 are unprotected, so a stored website that parses to a host but raises `URI::InvalidURIError` on re-parsing (for example containing spaces or invalid characters in the path) will raise out of `website_name` and break serialization of the whole user profile instead of falling back to the host name.

findings.title: Same-domain detection is inconsistent for website subdomains of the instance domain
findings.body: If the website is a subdomain of the instance domain (website `blog.example.com`, instance `example.com`), the first branch fails, the equal-label-count branch fails, and `discourse_host.ends_with?('.' + website_host)` is also false, so only the host is shown. The reverse parent case and the sibling case (`www.example.com` vs `forum.example.com`, line 146) do show the full path, so equally same-registrable-domain URLs are treated inconsistently and the feature silently does not apply to subdomain websites.

findings.title: New website_name branches and edge cases are untested
findings.body: The new specs cover only unrelated domains, exact host match, and website-as-parent. They do not cover the sibling-subdomain branch added at serializer lines 144-146, a website subdomain of the instance host, a website without a scheme or with invalid URI characters, a blank website (verifying the attribute is omitted), or the TL0-anonymous restriction. Regressions in those branches, including serialization errors and information leakage, would pass this suite.
